speakerDirection: Say this naturally as you would to someone you know. Regional wording is welcome.

speakerDirection: Speak naturally and politely in your regional Kannada.

meaningKannada: ‘ಇಂದು ತುಂಬಾ ಮಳೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ’ ಎಂಬ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಸಹಜವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ
speakerDirection: Use your normal local words and pronunciation.
